defects.title: Unreadable type and broken colors
defects.notes: Comic Sans, clashing yellow/magenta, no box-sizing.

defects.title: Header overlaps and floats apart
defects.notes: Brand, generation chip, and Improve button sit on top of each other.

defects.title: No page layout
defects.notes: Shell is too wide, hero is rotated, KPIs float and overflow.

defects.title: Pipeline and widgets have no structure
defects.notes: Steps and worker cards are raw blocks with no rhythm.

defects.title: Depth tree and memory are unusable
defects.notes: Nested nodes collapse; memory of prior work is easy to miss.

defects.title: No quality pass or mobile layout
defects.notes: No spacing system, no responsive stack, no visual hierarchy.

defects.title: Modular type scale
defects.notes: Locked a 12/14/16/22/28/38 scale so titles, kicker, and body stay in one family.

defects.title: Spacing rhythm
defects.notes: Replaced ad-hoc gaps with a 4px rhythm so cards, panels, and the shell share one beat.

defects.title: Visible focus states
defects.notes: Gave buttons, memory rows, and the Improve action a mint focus ring that survives dark UI.

defects.title: Contrast and muted text
defects.notes: Raised muted copy and borders so captions stay AA against the dark cards.

defects.title: Depth tree polish
defects.notes: Role dots, status edges, and hanging gutters make the recursive tree scannable at a glance.

defects.title: KPI visual hierarchy
defects.notes: Made merged the hero metric and put supporting 10k stats on a quieter scale.

defects.title: Subtle motion
defects.notes: Added short, low-amplitude transitions on hover and paint so the UI feels finished, not jumpy.

defects.title: Memory panel readability
defects.notes: Separated open defects from accepted history and gave each row a clearer meta line.

defects.title: Accessibility landmarks
defects.notes: Reduced motion, skip target, and hit-area fixes so the console is usable with keyboard and AT.

defects.title: Mobile density
defects.notes: Tightened phone layout: smaller type, stacked actions, and cards that do not waste vertical space.

defects.title: Button states
defects.notes: Primary and ghost now have hover, active, and disabled treatments that match the mint system.

defects.title: Layered elevation
defects.notes: Hero and panels sit above the page wash; inner cards stay flatter so depth reads as hierarchy.

defects.title: Tabular numbers
defects.notes: Generation chip, KPIs, and tree depth use IBM Plex Mono tabular figures so columns do not jitter.

defects.title: Quiet scrollbars
defects.notes: Tree and memory panes get thin, dark scrollbars so overflow does not flash OS chrome.

defects.title: Status color semantics
defects.notes: Open / fixed / selected states now share one amber-mint language across banner, pills, and rows.

history.title: Readable type and color system
history.summary: Replaced the broken type with a real dark palette, box-sizing, and Instrument Sans.
history.notes: Highest-quality base tokens. Later patches must keep contrast and box-sizing.

history.title: Header that actually lays out
history.summary: Separated brand, generation memory, and the Improve action so they no longer overlap.
history.notes: Chip and primary button stay on one row on desktop.

history.title: Page width, hero, and KPI grid
history.summary: Constrained the shell, un-rotated the hero, and put the 10k stats on a real grid.
history.notes: Do not let KPIs float or the shell exceed the viewport.

history.title: Pipeline and widget cards
history.summary: Gave planner / worker / verifier / merge and worker widgets a shared card language.
history.notes: Tone stripes stay; no dotted magenta leftovers.

history.title: Recursive tree and agent memory
history.summary: Made the depth tree scannable and pinned the memory of every accepted repair.
history.notes: Memory is the source of truth. Do not hide open defects.

history.title: Quality pass and mobile stack
history.summary: Tightened spacing, shadows, and a one-column mobile layout so the repaired UI holds up in a screenshot.
history.notes: Last open defect. After this the agent has rebuilt the console from memory.

history.title: Modular type scale
history.summary: Locked a 12/14/16/22/28/38 scale so titles, kicker, and body stay in one family.
history.notes: Keep Instrument Sans. Never restore Comic Sans or Papyrus after gen 0.

history.title: Spacing rhythm
history.summary: Replaced ad-hoc gaps with a 4px rhythm so cards, panels, and the shell share one beat.
history.notes: 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 24 / 32. Do not invent random pixel gaps.

history.title: Visible focus states
history.summary: Gave buttons, memory rows, and the Improve action a mint focus ring that survives dark UI.
history.notes: Keyboard users must see where they are. Do not remove outlines.

history.title: Contrast and muted text
history.summary: Raised muted copy and borders so captions stay AA against the dark cards.
history.notes: Muted is #9aa3b5 minimum. Do not drop body text below #c2cad8.

history.title: Depth tree polish
history.summary: Role dots, status edges, and hanging gutters make the recursive tree scannable at a glance.
history.notes: Keep left-rail kids and depth badges. Do not collapse nested nodes.

history.title: KPI visual hierarchy
history.summary: Made merged the hero metric and put supporting 10k stats on a quieter scale.
history.notes: Merged stays loud. Do not equalize every KPI or restore 400-ticket labels.

history.title: Subtle motion
history.summary: Added short, low-amplitude transitions on hover and paint so the UI feels finished, not jumpy.
history.notes: 150–180ms, opacity and border only. No bounce, no spin.

history.title: Memory panel readability
history.summary: Separated open defects from accepted history and gave each row a clearer meta line.
history.notes: Memory remains the source of truth. Do not hide history.

history.title: Accessibility landmarks
history.summary: Reduced motion, skip target, and hit-area fixes so the console is usable with keyboard and AT.
history.notes: Honor prefers-reduced-motion. Keep 44px targets on primary actions.

history.title: Mobile density
history.summary: Tightened phone layout: smaller type, stacked actions, and cards that do not waste vertical space.
history.notes: Phone is a first-class surface. Keep one column under 640px.

history.title: Button states
history.summary: Primary and ghost now have hover, active, and disabled treatments that match the mint system.
history.notes: Disabled is wait, not invisible. Keep the mint fill.

history.title: Layered elevation
history.summary: Hero and panels sit above the page wash; inner cards stay flatter so depth reads as hierarchy.
history.notes: One shadow language. No neon glow.

history.title: Tabular numbers
history.summary: Generation chip, KPIs, and tree depth use IBM Plex Mono tabular figures so columns do not jitter.
history.notes: Mono is for numbers only. Body copy stays Instrument Sans.

history.title: Quiet scrollbars
history.summary: Tree and memory panes get thin, dark scrollbars so overflow does not flash OS chrome.
history.notes: Keep overflow-x on the tree. Do not clip node labels.

history.title: Status color semantics
history.summary: Open / fixed / selected states now share one amber-mint language across banner, pills, and rows.
history.notes: Amber means open work. Mint means accepted. Do not reintroduce yellow/magenta gen-0 clash.
